example.en: Please make a copy of this document for the meeting.
example.zh: 请为会议复印一份这个文件。

example.en: The lecture starts at three o'clock in the afternoon.
example.zh: 讲座在下午三点开始。

example.en: I received a letter from the university about my application.
example.zh: 我收到了大学关于我申请的信件。

example.en: You need to book your train ticket in advance.
example.zh: 你需要提前预订火车票。

example.en: Public transportation is very convenient in this city.
example.zh: 这个城市的公共交通非常便利。

example.en: Setting clear academic goals helps students achieve better results.
example.zh: 设定明确的学术目标有助于学生取得更好的成绩。

example.en: Renewable energy is becoming more important for our environment.
example.zh: 可再生能源对我们的环境变得越来越重要。

example.en: This internship will give you valuable work experience.
example.zh: 这次实习将给你宝贵的工作经验。

example.en: The winter semester usually begins in January.
example.zh: 冬季学期通常在一月开始。

example.en: This is the second time I have visited this museum.
example.zh: 这是我第二次参观这个博物馆。

example.en: Many international students choose to study in America.
example.zh: 许多国际学生选择在美国学习。

example.en: Britain has a rich history and cultural heritage.
example.zh: 英国拥有丰富的历史和文化遗产。

example.en: London is one of the most popular destinations for tourists.
example.zh: 伦敦是最受游客欢迎的目的地之一。

example.en: England has many prestigious universities and colleges.
example.zh: 英格兰有许多著名的大学和学院。

example.en: Scotland is famous for its beautiful landscapes and historic castles.
example.zh: 苏格兰以其美丽的风景和历史悠久的城堡而闻名。

example.en: Queensland offers excellent opportunities for studying marine biology.
example.zh: 昆士兰为学习海洋生物学提供了绝佳的机会。

example.en: Sydney is the largest city in Australia.
example.zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚最大的城市。

example.en: Adelaide is known for its festivals and quality education.
example.zh: 阿德莱德以其节日和优质教育而闻名。

example.en: Melbourne has a diverse culture and vibrant arts scene.
example.zh: 墨尔本拥有多元文化和充满活力的艺术氛围。

example.en: Perth is located on the west coast of Australia.
example.zh: 珀斯位于澳大利亚西海岸。

example.en: The fire alarm went off during the examination.
example.zh: 考试期间火灾警报响了。

example.en: She is studying business management at a local college.
example.zh: 她在当地一所学院学习商业管理。

example.en: Students are divided into teams for the group project.
example.zh: 学生们被分成小组完成小组项目。

example.en: The gym membership includes access to all facilities.
example.zh: 健身房会员资格包括使用所有设施。

example.en: International students may face difficulties adjusting to a new culture.
example.zh: 国际学生可能在适应新文化方面面临困难。

example.en: The beach is a popular place for relaxation on weekends.
example.zh: 海滩是周末放松的热门场所。

example.en: The underground train system is the fastest way to travel.
example.zh: 地铁系统是最快的出行方式。

example.en: Students should plan their spending carefully to manage their budget.
example.zh: 学生应该仔细规划支出以管理预算。

example.en: The construction site is located near the university campus.
example.zh: 建筑工地位于大学校园附近。

example.en: The recreation center offers various sports and activities.
example.zh: 娱乐中心提供各种运动和活动。

example.en: Renting property near campus can be quite expensive.
example.zh: 在校园附近租房可能相当昂贵。

example.en: Students need to learn effective time management skills.
example.zh: 学生需要学习有效的时间管理技能。

example.en: All students have access to computers in the library.
example.zh: 所有学生都可以使用图书馆的电脑。

example.en: The botany course includes studying different plant species.
example.zh: 植物学课程包括研究不同的植物物种。

example.en: Please reserve a table at the study room for our group.
example.zh: 请为我们小组在自习室预订一张桌子。

example.en: The university provides excellent support services for students.
example.zh: 大学为学生提供优秀的支持服务。

example.en: Students have a wide choice of elective courses.
example.zh: 学生有广泛的选修课程可供选择。

example.en: The library building features beautiful glass architecture.
example.zh: 图书馆大楼具有美丽的玻璃建筑特色。

example.en: We conducted a survey to understand student satisfaction.
example.zh: 我们进行了一项调查以了解学生满意度。

example.en: Don't forget to bring your passport for international travel.
example.zh: 国际旅行时别忘了带上护照。

example.en: The library offers a wide range of academic resources.
example.zh: 图书馆提供广泛的学术资源。

example.en: The customer service at the bookstore is very helpful.
example.zh: 书店的客户服务非常有帮助。

example.en: Final exams will be held in the examination hall.
example.zh: 期末考试将在考场举行。

example.en: Failure is an important part of the learning process.
example.zh: 失败是学习过程的重要组成部分。

example.en: The professor gave a practical demonstration in the laboratory.
example.zh: 教授在实验室进行了实际演示。

example.en: The university hosts an international festival every year.
example.zh: 大学每年举办一次国际节日。

example.en: Belfast is the capital city of Northern Ireland.
example.zh: 贝尔法斯特是北爱尔兰的首府。

example.en: Ireland is known for its friendly people and green landscapes.
example.zh: 爱尔兰以其友好的人民和绿色的风景而闻名。

example.en: Dublin has several world-class universities and research centers.
example.zh: 都柏林有几所世界级的大学和研究中心。

example.en: Australia attracts thousands of international students each year.
example.zh: 澳大利亚每年吸引数千名国际学生。

example.en: The narrator provides important context throughout the audio recording.
example.zh: 叙述者在整个录音中提供重要的背景信息。

example.en: Living costs in major cities are generally higher than in small towns.
example.zh: 大城市的生活成本通常高于小城镇。

example.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds enrich classroom discussions.
example.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生丰富了课堂讨论。

example.en: The main campus is located on Park Avenue.
example.zh: 主校区位于公园大道。

example.en: Senior students often mentor first-year undergraduates.
example.zh: 大四学生经常指导一年级本科生。

example.en: You need to pay a deposit before moving into the apartment.
example.zh: 在搬进公寓之前你需要支付押金。

example.en: Students can attend extra tutorials to improve their grades.
example.zh: 学生可以参加额外的辅导课来提高成绩。

example.en: Listen to the tape carefully and answer the questions.
example.zh: 仔细听录音带并回答问题。

example.en: Choose an appropriate title for your research paper.
example.zh: 为你的研究论文选择一个合适的标题。

example.en: Understanding local culture helps international students adapt better.
example.zh: 了解当地文化有助于国际学生更好地适应。

example.en: The library stays open until dark during exam period.
example.zh: 考试期间图书馆一直开放到天黑。

example.en: Maintaining regular study habits is essential for academic success.
example.zh: 保持规律的学习习惯对学术成功至关重要。

example.en: The final project accounts for forty percent of the course grade.
example.zh: 期末项目占课程成绩的百分之四十。

example.en: Most universities have winter break in December.
example.zh: 大多数大学在十二月有寒假。

example.en: Assignment submissions are due in November.
example.zh: 作业提交截止日期在十一月。

example.en: The beginning of the semester is always very busy.
example.zh: 学期开始时总是非常忙碌。

example.en: The main purpose of this course is to develop critical thinking.
example.zh: 这门课程的主要目的是培养批判性思维。

example.en: Developing an interest in reading improves language skills.
example.zh: 培养阅读兴趣可以提高语言技能。

example.en: The decoration of the conference hall looks professional.
example.zh: 会议厅的装饰看起来很专业。

example.en: The course covers patterns of human migration throughout history.
example.zh: 该课程涵盖了整个历史中人类迁徙的模式。

example.en: The student union is organizing a welcome party.
example.zh: 学生会正在组织欢迎晚会。

example.en: Building good relationships with classmates is important.
example.zh: 与同学建立良好的关系很重要。

example.en: Environmental science is becoming an increasingly popular major.
example.zh: 环境科学正在成为越来越受欢迎的专业。

example.en: Medical researchers are working to find cures for various diseases.
example.zh: 医学研究人员正在努力寻找各种疾病的治疗方法。

example.en: We have a lecture every Monday morning at nine.
example.zh: 我们每周一早上九点有一节课。

example.en: The seminar is scheduled for Wednesday afternoon.
example.zh: 研讨会安排在周三下午。

example.en: This building was constructed in the nineteenth century.
example.zh: 这座建筑建于十九世纪。

example.en: The laboratory has modern equipment for scientific research.
example.zh: 实验室拥有现代化的科学研究设备。

example.en: Different teaching methods work better for different students.
example.zh: 不同的教学方法对不同的学生更有效。

example.en: The location of the university is convenient for public transport.
example.zh: 大学的地理位置便于公共交通。

example.en: Students can get discounts on public transport.
example.zh: 学生可以获得公共交通折扣。

example.en: The campus has excellent facilities for sports and recreation.
example.zh: 校园拥有出色的体育和娱乐设施。

example.en: Students are encouraged to share their ideas in class.
example.zh: 鼓励学生在课堂上分享他们的观点。

example.en: The university attracts students from all over the world.
example.zh: 这所大学吸引来自世界各地的学生。

example.en: Many students study in the coffee shop on campus.
example.zh: 许多学生在校园的咖啡店学习。

example.en: The meeting room is on the third floor of the building.
example.zh: 会议室在大楼的三楼。

example.en: This is my fourth year studying at this university.
example.zh: 这是我在这所大学学习的第四年。

example.en: Understanding the cause of the problem is the first step.
example.zh: 了解问题的起因是第一步。

example.en: Social activities help students make new friends.
example.zh: 社交活动帮助学生结交新朋友。

example.en: Each training session lasts approximately two hours.
example.zh: 每节培训课程大约持续两小时。

example.en: Female students make up sixty percent of the class.
example.zh: 女学生占班级的百分之六十。

example.en: The train station is just five minutes from campus.
example.zh: 火车站离校园只有五分钟路程。

example.en: The shared kitchen in the dormitory is well equipped.
example.zh: 宿舍的共用厨房设备齐全。

example.en: Joining a club is a great way to meet people.
example.zh: 加入俱乐部是认识人的好方法。

example.en: American universities are popular among international students.
example.zh: 美国大学在国际学生中很受欢迎。

example.en: The spring semester usually ends in March.
example.zh: 春季学期通常在三月结束。

example.en: Registration for next semester opens in February.
example.zh: 下学期的注册在二月开放。

example.en: New Zealand offers high-quality education in a beautiful environment.
example.zh: 新西兰在优美的环境中提供高质量的教育。

example.en: Cambridge is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities.
example.zh: 剑桥是最古老和最负盛名的大学之一。

example.en: Social media has changed the way students communicate.
example.zh: 社交媒体改变了学生的交流方式。
